elements.text: Sure thing! Let me know if I can be of any more assistance.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Lands ~1s after the bubble has settled, on one of the evenly spaced percussive streaks of the music bed; no visual change at that moment.

sfx_review.label: unsure

pattern.description: A new AI agent chat bubble and its avatar appear below the existing thread in one beat: instant fade-in with a short upward drift that decelerates into place.
pattern.why_premium: The message lands right after the narration line 'here's the best part', with a fast attack and long ease-out tail so it reads as arriving rather than cutting in, while the rest of the thread stays still.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo([avatar, bubble], {autoAlpha: 0, y: 16}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'expo.out', stagger: 0}).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180}}); opacity = interpolate(p, [0, 0.3], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [16, 0]) on avatar and bubble together.

notes: Filmstrip crops show small positional jitter between frames; the entrance direction (slide_up vs slight scale) is uncertain. camera.move is none. Both SFX candidates fall after the burst ends.
